body:
A `429 Too Many Requests` comes back without `X-RateLimit-Remaining` nor `Retry-After`, so clients cannot back off.

### Steps

1. Send 101 requests in a minute with one key
2. Look at the 101st answer's headers

<!-- triage: confirmed by the API team -->

### Expected

The same rate limit headers as on a 200, plus `Retry-After`.

comments.body: Confirmed: the middleware returns before the headers are set. Fix in #412.
Thanks! Could `Retry-After` be in seconds rather than a date? Our SDK only parses seconds.
Seconds it is, as the RFC allows both.
